Original paper experimentally localizes a single-AA-level pocket and preserves fold, but source pH and exact experimental residue list/PDB construct must be verified before primary scoring. Later reviews identify Trp62/Trp63 but computational interpretation must not substitute for original experimental labels.

Original paper verifies human common-type AcP interacting with 4-nm silica by NMR + proteomics and reports a common two-alpha-helix interaction surface with greater native-structure retention on 4-nm than 15-nm particles. PDB 2K7K remains the pre-score WT human common-type AcP structure candidate. Exact source-defined residue/CSP set and assay pH are still not directly recovered from the original SI, so remain DEFER; do not convert generic helix spans or peptide/acetylation ratios into gold labels.

Original paper verifies human common-type AcP interacting with 15-nm silica by NMR + proteomics and reports the same broad two-alpha-helix interaction surface, but the 15-nm condition shows greater conformational perturbation than 4-nm and therefore has additional Level-2 risk. PDB 2K7K remains the pre-score WT human common-type AcP candidate. Exact source residue/CSP set and pH are still not directly recovered; K99 alone is insufficient. Remain DEFER and cluster with 4-nm condition.

Original Nano Letters study directly supports diameter-dependent preferential adsorption/orientation by position-specific chemical modification + proteolysis-MS, and official SI is nl2044524_si_001.pdf. The related RPI dissertation was located but only abstract-level text is presently accessible. Exact original experimental modified/protected residue sites, assay pH, and construct/numbering remain not jointly verified, so this condition remains DEFER. Provisional PDB assignment must not be treated as construct-verified and no later MD contact residues may be imported as gold.

Open-access source verifies human 15N-ubiquitin, 20 mM PBS at pH 6.5, citrate-stabilized Au NP1, and small CSPs with preserved folded ubiquitin. Authors report NP1/NP2 interacting with distinct ubiquitin regions, but the complete NP1-specific experimental CSP residue set is in SI (ao9b03716_si_001.pdf) and has not yet been extracted directly. Main-text discussion of Q2/L15/E18 partly references prior Rossi AuNP work and must not be substituted as this study's gold set. Remain DEFER; confirmatory/overlapping with existing ubiquitin-Au family.

Open-access source verifies human 15N-ubiquitin, 20 mM PBS at pH 6.5, and NP2 as an Au core with an exposed condensed SiO2 shell; frozen chemistry mapping is therefore metal-oxide. Ubiquitin remains folded with only small CSPs and authors state NP1 and NP2 engage distinct regions. Exact NP2-specific CSP residue set is contained in SI (ao9b03716_si_001.pdf) and has not yet been extracted directly, so remain DEFER rather than infer a region from comparison with prior AuNP literature.
